entities.name: Vps54 (Q9VLC0)
observations: Supplied 768-aa sequence matches reviewed Drosophila melanogaster Vps54 (UniProt Q9VLC0) at 100% identity and 100% query coverage.
Vps54 is a GARP complex component implicated in retrograde transport from endosomes to the Golgi/TGN; reference annotation includes Golgi and trans-Golgi network localization.
Pfam scanning identified Vps54_N (PF10475.16; residues 264–420) and Vps54 (PF07928.18; residues 708–768) in the query.
Sequence-derived estimates: molecular weight 85,586 Da; theoretical pI 7.05; GRAVY −0.280.
